source_task.previous_summary: P4-19 proved that old prism/reports anchors are not ready for delete-last retirement; post-freeze reports, canonical references, alias/query contract and destructive authorization remain blockers.

claim_boundary.allowed_user_claim: After P4-19, RedCap selected the next safe pre-release slice: a non-destructive internal-control-plane support-copy-first continuation. No release blocker is closed by this route decision.
forbidden_claims: The selected next slice has already been implemented.
Old prism/reports anchors have been retired, deleted, replaced, or redirected.
Prism raw run evidence has been cleaned or pruned.
Layer A product scope has been decided.
RedCap is ready for public npm/CLI release.

candidate_matrix.title: Internal-control-plane physical split continuation
candidate_matrix.reason: It is one of the largest remaining release blockers. Claude Code selected it, and Cap adjudicates it as the next route because it can be advanced as a non-destructive support-copy-first slice without touching release switches, credentials, old report anchors, raw evidence or Layer A product scope.

candidate_matrix.title: Old report alias / query gateway
candidate_matrix.reason: Kimi selected this as the smallest safe follow-up to P4-19. Cap keeps it as the next Prism-layer candidate, but does not select it now because P4-19 already preserved old anchors and the route should now move back to the larger internal-control-plane blocker instead of extending the localized Prism-report line indefinitely.

candidate_matrix.title: Prism raw run evidence retention / cleanup
candidate_matrix.reason: Any raw evidence cleanup may break auditability and requires explicit preservation proof plus Norven approval before apply.

candidate_matrix.title: Layer A product boundary decision
candidate_matrix.reason: Layer A inclusion/exclusion is a Norven-reserved product decision and cannot be delegated to Cap or Prism.

candidate_matrix.title: Formal npm / CLI publish
candidate_matrix.reason: Formal publish requires license, registry, credentials, package privacy and explicit publish authorization decisions.

selected_next_slice.title: R1 internal-control-plane support-copy-first continuation after old-anchor route selection
scope: Advance the internal-control-plane physical split using a non-destructive support-copy-first slice.
Prefer package-visible runtime support files, compatibility wrappers or contract mirrors that reduce internal-control-plane release blocker scope.
Do not delete, move, rename, replace or symlink-switch old prism/reports anchors.
Do not clean or prune prism/runs raw evidence.
Do not decide Layer A product scope.
Do not change release switches, package privacy, registry, credentials or license.
minimum_acceptance: machine-readable support-copy-first manifest for the selected internal-control-plane subset
checker proving the slice is non-destructive and does not close release blockers prematurely
Prism review by Claude Code and Kimi when available

deferred_candidates.follow_up_rule: After at least one internal-control-plane continuation slice or if a Prism-layer checker starts failing because of old report lookup ambiguity, re-evaluate a bounded old report alias/query gateway task.
Only enter after explicit preservation proof and human authorization for evidence cleanup.
Only enter after Norven asks for Layer A product scope adjudication.
Only enter after release readiness is green and Norven confirms license, registry, package privacy and publish authorization.

adjudication.reason: Claude Code recommended A because it attacks the largest remaining release blocker; Kimi recommended B because it is the smallest safe follow-up to P4-19. Cap selects A because P4-19 already preserved old anchors and proved no destructive old-anchor action is allowed now. Continuing with B would further deepen the localized Prism-report line while internal-control-plane remains the larger release blocker. A remains acceptable only as a non-destructive support-copy-first slice.
adjudication.tie_breaker: When one option is smaller but continues a localized line that has already been safely deferred, and another option addresses a larger release blocker without crossing human gates, choose the larger blocker as a bounded non-destructive slice.

agents.reason: Availability filter selected Claude Code and Kimi quorum; Gemini was not needed for this route-only review.
Protected fallback policy: Copilot is not called when Claude Code and Kimi are available.
